user.title: Travel map
user.description: Choose the folder that holds your trips: one folder per trip, with one subfolder per place. The folder does not have to exist yet; you can add the network storage afterwards.

data_description.path: Absolute path as Home Assistant sees it. Network storage added with usage Media is mounted under /media.

reconfigure.title: Change the folder
reconfigure.description: Point this entry at another folder of trips.

data_description.path: Absolute path as Home Assistant sees it. Network storage added with usage Media is mounted under /media.

error.path_not_absolute: Enter an absolute path, starting with a slash.
error.path_not_allowed: Home Assistant may not read this folder. Use a folder under /media, or add it to allowlist_external_dirs.
error.path_not_a_folder: This path is a file, not a folder.

abort.already_configured: This folder is already set up.

data_description.scan_interval: How often the folder is checked for new trips, places and photos.

rescan_failed.message: The folder {path} could not be scanned. Check that the network storage is connected.

missing_coordinates.title: Places without coordinates on the travel map
missing_coordinates.description:
{count} place(s) have no marker, because their photos carry no GPS data and trip.yaml gives no coordinates: {places}.

Add `lat` and `lon` for each of them under `places` in the trip.yaml of that trip, then press Scan now.

folder_missing.title: The folder of the travel map is not available
folder_missing.description:
The folder `{path}` does not exist, or Home Assistant cannot read it.

If you have not added the network storage yet: go to Settings → System → Storage → Add network storage and choose usage Media. If it was there before, check that the NAS is on.

The integration looks again every minute; this message clears itself once the folder is found.
